name: edge-side-in-a-generated-file
description: A declaration of a generated file that a side of a declared cross-language edge names in the analyzer's own language is judged by its references, because the edge stands for a use only the other language decides. The side naming a function the entry calls is live. The side naming a function nothing references is dead, holding the pending finding the function carries, and that finding is not among the report's findings. A declaration of the same file that no edge names stays retained by the generated-file class, so the file reports no finding of its own.
